newsitem.title: BRAZIL: SOCCER-RED CARD SPECIALISTS INCLUDED IN BRAZIL SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RED CARD SPECIALISTS INCLUDED IN BRAZIL SQUAD.

text.p: Striker Edmundo and midfielder Djalminha, who have collected six red cards between them this year, were named on Wednesday in the Brazil squad for next month's European tour and Copa America.
Coach Mario Zagallo also included striker Romario, another player with a reputation for being problematical.
Zagallo has stated in the past that he would not shy away from volatile players, providing they do not cause any trouble while with the national team.
Zagallo named the 11 home-based players on Wednesday, having picked his foreign-based contingent the week before.
The other home-based players were goalkeepers Taffarel and Carlos Germano, defenders Cafu, Goncalves, Celio Silva and Marcio Santos, midfielder Denilson and striker Paulo Nunes.
Brazil visit Norway for a friendly on May 30, then play France, Italy and England in a four-team tournament in France from June 3 to 10 before flying to Bolivia for the Copa America.
Goalkeepers - Taffarel (Atletico Mineiro), Carlos Germano (Vasco da Gama)
Defenders - Cafu (Palmeiras), Celio Silva (Corinthians), Goncalves (Botafogo), Marcio Santos (Atletico Mineiro), Aldair (Roma), Roberto Carlos (Real Madrid), Ze Maria (Parma)

Midfielders - Djalminha (Palmeiras), Denilson (Sao Paulo), Cesar Sampaio (Yokohama Flugels), Dunga (Jubilo Iwata), Flavio Conceicao (Deportivo Coruna), Giovanni (Barcelona), Leonardo (Paris St Germain), Mauro Silva (Deportivo Coruna), Ze Roberto (Real Madrid)
Forwards - Ronaldo (Barcelona), Romario (Flamengo), Paulo Nunes (Gremio), Edmundo (Vasco da Gama)
